L1.DESC: May occur only in exceptional circumstances

L5.LABEL: Almost certain

L2.LABEL: Minor
L2.DESC: Slight impact, manageable with normal resources

L4.LABEL: Major
L4.DESC: Significant impact on operations or compliance

L5.LABEL: Critical
L5.DESC: Severe impact, threatens continuity or leads to serious penalties
